# EXACERBATION OF CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE (COPD)

Exacerbation of COPD (ECOPD): dyspnea and/or cough and sputum worsening over < 14 days. An acute change in one or more of the following:

- Increased cough frequency and severity
- Increased sputum volume and/or changes in character
- Increased dyspnea

Dyspnea differential: acute coronary syndrome, worsening heart failure, pulmonary embolism, pneumonia, medication non-adherence. Test for influenza and COVID.

---

Therapy:
## Inpatient

Available evidence is limited but suggests antibiotics are beneficial for COPD exacerbations in hospitalized patients. Antibiotics are strongly recommended for all patients admitted to the ICU for COPD exacerbation and those with sputum purulence (new or increased from baseline).

Antibiotics are not routinely recommended for non-critically ill patients with clear non-infectious causes for exacerbations (e.g. medication non-adherence, environmental exposures) or known viral infections.

### NOTE: Fluoroquinolones are not listed as a choice because of the risk of serious side effects outweigh the benefits.

[Fluoroquinolones FDA Serious Adverse Reactions](orz-gtx-abx-idp-fluoroquinolones-fda-warnings)

### General Ward patients

Preferred:

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h R for 5 days](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)

< OR >

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h DI for 5 days](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)

< OR >

[Azithromycin 500mg PO once, then 250mg q24h days 2-5 O](orz-set-abx-azithromycin-po-500-250-once-q24h-x4days)

Unable to tolerate oral antibiotics:

[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h R for 5 days](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q6h)

History of Pseudomonas in a respiratory isolate in the past year:

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R for 5 days](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

### ICU patients

Preferred:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h R for 5 days](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)

History of Pseudomonas in a respiratory isolate in the past year or immunosuppression:

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R for 5 days](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

< OR >

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R for 5 days](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)

## Outpatient

Patients at risk for poor outcomes are most likely to benefit from early, appropriate antibiotics and close follow-up. Risk factors: age > 65, FEV1 < 50% predicted, 2 or more exacerbations in the past year, hospitalization for exacerbation in the past year, continuous supplemental oxygen, ischemic heart disease or heart failure.

A home action plan with on demand oral corticosteroids and antibiotic is recommended if a patient with moderate or severe COPD had an exacerbation requiring treatment (outpatient, ER, or inpatient) in the previous 12 months.

### COPD Management & Respiratory Symptom Treatment

[Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) Symptomatic Therapy](ari-symptomatic-therapy)

### Antibiotics:

Antibiotics recommended for patients with moderate or severe chronic COPD
plus an exacerbation with 2 or more of the following:

- Increase or change in sputum purulence
- Increased sputum volume
- Increased dyspnea

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for COPD exacerbation 5 days ($) DI](psozid2-doxycycline-5ds-100mg-po-bid-copd-exacerbation)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-doxycycline-5ds-100mg-po-bid-copd-exacerbation)
< OR >
[Trimethoprim 1 DS tablet BID for COPD exacerbation 5 days ($) R,DI](psozid2-tmp-smx-5days-1ds-tab-bid-copd-exacerbation)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-tmp-smx-5days-1ds-tab-bid-copd-exacerbation)

### Antibiotics if risk factors for poor outcomes:

FEV1 < 50% predicted, 2 or more exacerbations in the past year, hospitalization for exacerbation in the past year, continuous supplemental oxygen, ischemic heart disease or heart failure
[Azithromycin 500 mg PO x1 on day 1 then 250 mg PO qday for 4days ($) M](psozid2-azith-500mg-po-x1-then-250mg-qdayx4-copd-exacerbation)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-azithromycin-500mg-pox1-250qdayx4-copd-exacerbation)

< OR >
[Amoxicillin/clav 875/125 mg po bid COPD exacerbation 5 days ($) R](psozid2-amoxicillin-clav-875-125-bid-5days-copd-exacerbation)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amoxicillin-clav-875-125-po-bid-copd-exacerbation-5days)

### Pseudomonas in respiratory isolate in past year:

[Levofloxacin 750mg PO qday for COPD Exacerbation for 5 days ($) R,DI](psozid2-levofloxacin-750mg-po-qday-copd-exacerbation-5-days)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-levofloxacin-750mg-po-qday-5days-copd-exacerbation)
